title: Radiation and Weather Estimated
description: A single time period of solar irradiance and weather data returned by the Solcast API. Used across live, forecast, and historic endpoints.

period_end.description: End time of the data period in UTC (ISO 8601).

period.description: Duration of the time period in ISO 8601 duration format.

ghi.description: Global Horizontal Irradiance in W/m². The total solar radiation received on a horizontal surface.

ghi90.description: GHI at the 90th percentile (optimistic scenario) in W/m².

ghi10.description: GHI at the 10th percentile (pessimistic scenario) in W/m².

ebh.description: Beam Horizontal Irradiance (direct beam on a horizontal surface) in W/m².

dni.description: Direct Normal Irradiance — direct solar radiation on a surface perpendicular to the sun in W/m².

dhi.description: Diffuse Horizontal Irradiance — scattered solar radiation on a horizontal surface in W/m².

air_temp.description: Air temperature at 2m height in degrees Celsius.

cloud_opacity.description: Cloud opacity as a percentage (0 = clear sky, 100 = fully overcast).

wind_speed_10m.description: Wind speed at 10m height in m/s.

wind_direction_10m.description: Wind direction at 10m height in degrees clockwise from north (0–360).

clearsky_ghi.description: Clear-sky Global Horizontal Irradiance (what GHI would be without clouds) in W/m².

clearsky_ebh.description: Clear-sky Beam Horizontal Irradiance in W/m².

clearsky_dni.description: Clear-sky Direct Normal Irradiance in W/m².

clearsky_dhi.description: Clear-sky Diffuse Horizontal Irradiance in W/m².

precipitable_water.description: Total column precipitable water in kg/m².

azimuth.description: Solar azimuth angle in degrees (0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west).

zenith.description: Solar zenith angle in degrees (0 = directly overhead, 90 = horizon).

elevation.description: Solar elevation angle in degrees above the horizon (complement of zenith).

relative_humidity.description: Relative humidity at 2m height as a percentage.

snow_soiling_rooftop.description: Estimated snow soiling loss factor for rooftop panels (0 = no loss, 1 = fully blocked).
